US-align was run on the same Cα files each time (`-mol prot -mm 1 -ter 1`; map frame adds `-se`). The first scoring used Version 20260920 (commit 1fa25a9), whose complex-mode search has an out-of-bounds bug that the authors fixed on 2026-10-12; with that build the search returned different TM-scores for identical inputs. All models were re-scored with Version 20261012 (commit 746ad8a). Because every method writes its model in the map's coordinate frame, the map-frame evaluation is a valid superposition that needs no search, and it is higher than the search result for a few models. The primary TM-score in Tables 1, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11 and 12 is the higher of the two corrected values; aligned Cα length and sequence identity (Tables 13 and 14) come from the same evaluation. The lower table lists every model for which the primary value differs from the first scoring, or the map frame from the search, by more than 0.01. Means under the search-only definition are in the third column.
